title: Meta-Evaluating Local LLMs: Rethinking Performance Metrics for Serious Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance and consistency of local LLMs acting as judges within a serious game centered on energy communities. While 'pro-social impact' is one of the metrics used to define a 'correct' response in the game, the study's primary objective is to meta-evaluate LLM performance using standard classification metrics (accuracy, TPR, TNR) rather than to benchmark or evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks specifically.
